behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert AND/OR short-circuit order, nested error identity, empty cases and first thrown value.
Assert legacy profile name precedence and either-contact success/failure messages.
docDelivery: Document combinator result shape, ordering/copies and empty semantics.
Explain existing profile composition without expanding validation rules.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Synchronous ordered AND/OR rule composition, short-circuit and error identity, existing profile rule behavior preserved. Up to 200000 error values per result or combined final output.
manualBehavior: Profile expresses name/contact logic through shared combinators rather than retaining duplicate control flow.
independence: Extract reusable AND/OR validation combinators preserving short-circuiting, error order and old schema outcomes.
